Verify the generated root URL and the documented health endpoint separately; a running container or HTTP 404 does not demonstrate a working deployment. Jellyfin defaults to HTTP 8096 at /. Leave BaseUrl empty; /jellyfin is only valid after an explicit matching network.xml BaseUrl and proxy configuration. JELLYFIN_PublishedServerUrl is the exact case-sensitive discovery variable, not a base-path setting. When changing qBittorrent’s WebUI listener, set WEBUI_PORT as well as the container/host port mapping; PUID, PGID and TZ are case-sensitive.
Navidrome uses port 4533, persistent /data and read-only /music; match the host media ownership.

Verify the generated root URL and the documented health endpoint separately; a running container or HTTP 404 does not demonstrate a working deployment. Immich requires a root origin on HTTP 2283 and does not support subpaths. Use the current release Compose dependencies and verify /api/server/ping; do not invent /immich. The official machine-learning image uses python3 /usr/src/healthcheck.py; do not override it with wget, which is absent from the runtime image.

Choose the server UDP listener and peer routes explicitly. WireGuard server provisioning is separate from an outbound Gluetun container.
Verify forwarding, peer AllowedIPs and the remote server before changing a default route.

Choose AdGuard Home or Pi-hole, not both. Current Pi-hole v6 uses FTLCONF_webserver_api_password and FTLCONF_dns_listeningMode, not legacy WEBPASSWORD; check DNS TCP/UDP 53 and host resolver conflicts.
Match server_url, persistent configuration, client enrolment and the current Headscale version; do not expose an unfinished control plane.
Prefer the existing LMS Caddy. If choosing another proxy, consult that proxy version’s docs before deployment; do not guess subpath support.
Choose Container versus OS deliberately; validate host networking, Bluetooth/USB adapter and MQTT authentication for the selected installation.
Frigate authenticated UI uses 8971. Keep unauthenticated port 5000 internal; explicitly validate RTSP/WebRTC ports and accelerator devices.
Select InfluxDB v2 explicitly when using its v2 API. Current Grafana OSS images use grafana/grafana; grafana/grafana-oss stops receiving updates from 12.4. Persist Grafana /var/lib/grafana.
Use the Apache image for HTTP port 80; the FPM variant’s port 9000 is not an HTTP web server. Persist /var/www/html and keep dependencies private.
Protect Syncthing’s GUI on 8384 separately from sync traffic; choose peer reachability and discovery deliberately.
Select restic or Borg, the repository backend and encryption credentials explicitly; verify a restore rather than just a successful backup exit.

Current MinIO Community is distributed as source only; do not assume a maintained prebuilt Community image or binary. Plan a reproducible source build or discuss another supported S3 implementation before deployment.

Distinguish Apache HTTP and FPM variants, persist /var/www/html, and explicitly plan imports and backups.
Set DOMAIN to the actual HTTPS origin and persist /data; verify browser access and recovery.
Persist the instance secret and match the external base URL to the real root origin.
Use the documented PostgreSQL variant and DATABASE_URL, container port 3000, and change the initial administrator password.
Choose the current ArchiveBox release’s installation flow and persistent archive before composing a deployment; do not mix commands from older releases.
Select a stable image; persist /var/www/FreshRSS/data and any extensions, and match base_url to the actual origin.

Current standard image is docker.stirlingpdf.com/stirlingtools/stirling-pdf, port 8080 and persistent /configs. Login is enabled by default; change the initial admin password rather than disabling login silently.
Use the release-matched Paperless Compose configuration, persistent consume/media/data paths and private database/Redis; match its external URL.
Choose the container image maintainer explicitly and follow that variant’s mounts; preserve APP_KEY and set APP_URL to the real external origin.
Use the current v2 release, port 3001 and persistent /app/data; do not place the SQLite data on NFS.
The LinuxServer variant requires APP_KEY and APP_URL, persistent /config and an explicit database selection. Match container HTTP 80/HTTPS 443 to chosen host ports.

Sunshine upstream does not recommend Docker for most users. Consider native host installation; verify display access, GPU encoding and client pairing before proposing a container.

SteamCMD alone is an installer, not a running game server. Obtain the chosen game publisher’s current server documentation and app ID before provisioning; no game-specific deployment has been validated.
Use the current maintained image documentation; verify UDP 2456-2457 and any additional mod/variant ports, persistent worlds and update/backup policy.
Use the matching image release; game port is UDP 34197, optional RCON is TCP 27015. Persist /factorio and protect tokens.
Current image requires TCP and UDP 7777 plus TCP 8888, with persistent /config. Do not reuse obsolete three-UDP-port instructions.
Choose vanilla or tModLoader explicitly and consult that version’s server instructions; preserve worlds and verify TCP 7777 when using its standard listener.
Select the actual games first and follow each selected publisher/image maintainer’s docs; generate a collision-free port plan rather than deploying generic idle templates.
